title: Common Completion Proof Profile v0
description: Minimal profile for mapping local agent completion proof into a shared structure.

task_id.description: Task identifier, hash, commit reference, or equivalent task reference.

proof_source.description: The source that supports the proof.

target_reference.description: Reference to the target system, git object, receipt id, or durable record.

validation_result.description: Whether the evidence supports the completion claim.

issuer.description: System, evaluator, or mechanism that issued the proof.
